entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That old lady totally elbowed me...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...But thanks to that, I remember now.
About what?
Wait, what about Ann?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, lemme get to it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's not worry about it for now...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's about a post online.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Here, look at this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why'd you leave without me!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got it all wrong; we got dragged into[n]this huge crowd and—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Eh, anyways. You gotta look at this too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This post might be about Madarame.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's it say?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "A master of the Japanese arts is[n]plagiarizing his pupil's work. Only[n]his public face is shown on TV."

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Plagiarizing!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I didn't think much of it when I first saw[n]it, but hearing "shack" and "Madarame"[n]triggered it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "His treatment of the pupils who live with[n]him is awful. He teaches nothing and bosses[n]them around."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "He treats them inhumanely, as if[n]disciplining a dog..."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Abuse on top of plagiarism, hm?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If this is real, it'll be a huge scandal.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if Kitagawa-kun posted this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, he IS a pupil of his.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Who knows? It's anonymous and all...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In that case...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's possible the Madarame we heard[n]about in Mementos is referring to the[n]same one.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A man like that, doing such a thing?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if we can ask that Shadow from[n]earlier about this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh. Actually, we just need to talk to him[n]in reality.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And how are we gonna go about[n]that? Are we gonna explain it all,[n]startin' with Mementos?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Besides, if we make a move out in[n]the open, there's the possibility that[n]Madarame will find out.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh... Yeah, right...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, what do you think about Madarame?[n]Doesn't he seem suspicious?
He does.
That post might be fake.
I don't know.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know, right? This all fits way too well[n]to just be a coincidence.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Still...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's this much overlap. Ain't it pretty[n]much settled?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If this post is legit, ain't this the kinda[n]target we've been waitin' for?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, yeah, but...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is it really true?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: By the way, what did you do about[n]the whole modeling thing?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kitagawa-kun gave me his contact info.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And the address to his sensei's atelier.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He said he lives there, right? Perfect[n]timing.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's try goin' tomorrow. We're off to[n]Madarame's house right after school!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh? You want me to model tomorrow!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is too sudden...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What? We're just gonna go talk to Kitagawa.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, that's what you meant...
